Enjoy a peaceful and comfortable stay for the whole family – just minutes from Gardermoen, but without the noise of the planes. 
The charming home is perfect for both vacation and business trips, with a short distance to conferences and events in the area. 
Here you can relax in quiet, rural surroundings close to nature. 
In summer, animals graze nearby, and the property borders the river Leira where you can borrow a canoe and enjoy nature.

The space
The property has a large lawn and a spacious courtyard with ample space for several cars. Here there is plenty of room to enjoy the outdoor area. 
On the plot you will find a barbecue that is free to use, perfect for pleasant meals outdoors on hot days.

Guest access
The whole house is available, except for one small room in the laundry room.

Other things to note
Please let us know if you would like towels, and we will provide them. There's hand soap in the toilets and shower soap in the bathroom.

Bed linen is provided to all guests and must be used if you do not bring your own. Each guest puts on the bed linen themselves.
